subject: Ops Insights add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards pricing and terms
messages:
From: Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@dataops.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@dataops.io
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ops Insights — observability add-ons pricing & SOW

Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Per our platform team’s ask, we need a clear breakdown for the observability add-ons you discussed — specifically: retention extension (up to 180 days), distributed tracing (full sampling vs. sampling rate options), and the advanced dashboard pack (real-time dashboards + custom widgets). Procurement also wants the commercial terms (monthly vs. committed annual pricing), any available bundle discounts, and the list of items you consider "base" vs. "paid add-on".

High level context: we’re evaluating Redwood as the primary inference serving provider for DataOps platform — likely start with a hosted deployment and move to dedicated in year two if performance and cost metrics pan out. Expected usage: ~12M tokens/month and ~300GB of observability data/month initially (ramp to ~750GB in 12 months).

Timeline: procurement needs preliminary pricing and a redlineable SOW by Aug 4 so legal can review. Can you confirm what you need from us (usage numbers, security docs, PO templates)? Also please include any discounts for a 24-month commit and whether the dashboard seats are per-user or capacity-based.

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Zhang
Director of Platform, DataOps Inc.
Attachments: DataOps_RFP-v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@dataops.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops Insights — observability add-ons pricing & SOW

Olivia — appreciate the detail. High level response below; I’ve attached a draft pricing spreadsheet and our standard SOW template to speed legal review.

What’s base vs. add-on (short):
- Base hosted plan includes: API, model catalog, basic telemetry (30d retention), token-level billing, and one standard dashboard.
- Paid add-ons: retention beyond 30 days (charged per GB-month), distributed tracing (sampling and full-trace options), advanced dashboard pack (real-time widgets, unlimited shared dashboards, and custom event correlation), and extended support SLAs.

Prelim pricing (ballpark, subject to usage verification):
- Retention: $0.12 per GB-month for standard retention up to 90 days; $0.09 per GB-month for 91–180 days when bundled.
- Tracing: Sampling mode (recommended) $0.05 per 10K traces; full sampling / high-fidelity traces $0.22 per 10K traces.
- Advanced dashboards: $450 per seat/month or $3,500 per capacity-unit/month (capacity unit covers up to 50 concurrent dashboards; recommended for platform-wide access).

Discounts: 12-month committed ARR: 18% off listed add-on rates; 24-month committed ARR: 28% off listed add-on rates. Additional 10% strategic discount available for customers who commit to Dedicated capacity in year two (applies to add-ons only when bundled in the contract).

Questions for you (to firm numbers):
- Confirm expected observability ingest (GB/month) and expected growth profile (you listed ~300GB -> 750GB).
- Will DataOps require full-trace fidelity for all services or just a subset of services (we typically recommend full sampling for 2–3 critical services and sampling for the rest).
- Number of dashboard power-users vs. viewer-only users.

Next steps: 1) If you’re OK, I’ll align Marissa (CS) to build a scoped SOW reflecting 180-day retention and full-trace for three services; 2) We’ll produce an updated pricing workbook reflecting your growth curve; 3) DocuSign/PO-ready contract by Aug 4 if we can lock usage.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call this week to go line-by-line.

—
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
Attachments: redwood_pricing_ops_addons_v2.xlsx (xlsx), Redwood_SOW_template.docx (docx)

From: Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@dataops.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@dataops.io
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops Insights — observability add-ons pricing & SOW

Karthik — thanks for the clear breakdown. A few follow-ups inline: 

> Retention: $0.09 per GB-month for 91–180 days when bundled.

Can you confirm whether that bundled rate requires an ingest commit (GB/mo) or ARR commit? Procurement typically expects uplifted discounts for committed volume. If the 28% 24-month discount is ARR-based, what does that look like for our expected consumption (approx 300GB growing to 750GB)?

> Tracing: full sampling $0.22 per 10K traces.

We likely need full sampling for at least three critical services (auth, billing, inference-router) and sampling for others — please reflect that in the SOW. Also, any levers to reduce tracing cost (e.g., TTL on traces, sampled-span aggregation) would be helpful for legal to see.

> Dashboards: $450 per seat/month or $3,500 per capacity-unit/month

We prefer capacity-based pricing, but procurement wants an equivalent blended rate for budgeting. Can you provide a model (example) that maps our anticipated 20 power-users + ~60 viewers to cost under the capacity unit option?

Procurement note: if we proceed with a two-year commitment, we will expect an enterprise-level SLA (4 nines), liability cap conversations, and a one-time onboarding credit. Is any of this negotiable in your standard enterprise package?

I’ve attached our RFP to help with SOW granularity. Legal needs the redlineable SOW and a final pricing sheet by Aug 4 to make the internal exec review.

Best,
Olivia

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@dataops.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops Insights — observability add-ons pricing & SOW

Olivia — thanks, I’ve updated the workbook and SOW per your asks and attached the two files (redwood_pricing_ops_addons_v2.xlsx, DataOps_RFP-response.pdf). Below is a concise commercial proposal so procurement has a single-page summary for exec review.

Proposal summary (DataOps Inc. — D-84721)
- Term: 24 months (start date TBD; pricing assumes 24-month committed ARR).
- Observability ingest: baseline 300GB/mo, linear ramp to 750GB/mo at month 12. Billing measured as GB-month.
- Retention: 180 days — blended rate $0.078 per GB-month after 24-month commitment (this reflects the 28% ARR discount applied to the bundled 91–180 band). Estimated monthly retention cost (month 1 baseline): 300 GB * $0.078 = $23.40K/month; month 12 projected: 750 GB * $0.078 = $58.5K/month.
- Tracing: full sampling for auth, billing, inference-router (estimated 75K traces/day across those services) priced at $0.22 per 10K traces; sampling for the rest at $0.05 per 10K traces. We’ve also included a pro rata TTL + aggregation option that reduces billed traces by ~18% for long-lived debug traces (details in workbook).
- Dashboards: capacity unit recommended. One capacity unit = up to 50 concurrent dashboards. For your 20 power-users + ~60 viewers we recommend 2 capacity units (covers growth and shared team dashboards). Base capacity pricing: $3,500/unit/month. After 24-month ARR discount (28%) the effective unit price = $2,520/unit/month. Estimated dashboards cost = 2 * $2,520 = $5,040/month.

Discounts & commercial levers:
- 24-month ARR commitment: 28% off add-on rates (applied above).
- Dedicated-capture kicker: if DataOps signs a Dedicated capacity commitment in year 2, Redwood will apply an additional 10% one-time credit against add-on spend during year 2 (not stackable with other promotional credits).
- Onboarding credit: one-time $25K onboarding credit for accepted 24-month deals (applied to first invoice).
- SLA: 99.99% uptime for core inference API included for Dedicated customers; hosted customers can upgrade to 99.99% as part of the enterprise add-on (fee-based). Liability cap and specific contract redlines are negotiable through legal — Marissa will coordinate.

Next actions I’ve taken:
- Attached updated pricing workbook with month-by-month model and a blended dashboard equivalency table.
- Attached SOW redline for your legal.
- If this looks ok, I’ll generate a DocuSign bundle for signature (we can include procurement PO or DocuSign first).

Can Marissa hop on the legal thread to confirm SLA language and Evelyn to approve the strategic discount? If procurement can confirm by Aug 4, we’ll meet your timeline.

Cheers,
Karthik
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_pricing_ops_addons_v2.xlsx (xlsx), DataOps_RFP-response.pdf (pdf)
